game_title: Palindrome Gate – Supply Cache Camp Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Frost Peaks – Supply Cache Camp, a high supply cache: the summit pilot must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Palindrome Gate: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate.
theme: Frost Peaks – Supply Cache Camp: a high supply cache
core_gameplay_loop: In Supply Cache Camp, repeat each round: Check whether a word reads the same backward to open the gate. Each round, ice hawks strike the summit beacon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the gate value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the summit beacon from ice hawks in Supply Cache Camp: keep the gate meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 33-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: gate drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 33-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 2 (intro tier): Palindrome Gate
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Palindrome Gate' (Week 8 slot 5), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Supply Cache Camp'.
